authorization_basis: Existing user goal authorizes minimum-case iteration with current-main Rust and remote-main Qwen settings. The accepted development candidate permits this separately frozen confirmation; no extra user approval is required.
gates_remaining: Frozen confirmation plan/controller/workflow must pass fork Linux preflight, including the real descendant cleanup test, before one explicit live dispatch.
Each runner revalidates current upstream main, exact accepted offline proof, fixed source/package and commands before exposing provider keys.
limits: This is prospective replication of an already observed single task, not held-out task generalization or a favorable benchmark set.
Both pairs must independently pass; do not pool the selected development pair.
All four scheduled slots must be reported, including failures and missing outcomes. No selective replacement.
Quality review is blinded independent Codex source audit, not a human or official SWE-QA grade.
Native image cache may be shared within each pair; outer wall is descriptive, not independently cleared-image timing.
Provider alias and backend can change; exact weights/live HTTP bodies are not attested.
scope: Exactly c01 and c02, one fresh hosted Linux runner per pair, serial jobs, each baseline then zg once. Four scheduled slots; no reuse of development answers or historical rows.

stopping.after_scheduled_pairs: Close after c01 and c02. Confirm the scoped-input candidate only if BOTH pairs independently satisfy every frozen pair condition. No pooling with development and no substitution of a secondary metric.
stopping.on_failure: Retain every failed, partial or skipped scheduled slot; no repair, retry, replacement or resampling in this phase.
stopping.scheduled_slot_policy: Within each repeat attempt baseline then zg at most once, even if baseline fails. If prior process or container cleanup is unconfirmed, retain the later slot as not_started and abort that pair. Each repeat uses a separate fresh runner.
